reading.body:
Digital Realty Silicon Valley SJC29 in Santa Clara, California, is operated by Digital Realty, but no IT capacity in megawatts has been published for this facility.

Without a published capacity figure, the facility cannot be sized against other data centers in this collection, or judged for whether it could plausibly host AI training infrastructure, which typically requires tens of megawatts and up. What is on record is the facility's location and operator, not its scale.

Digital Realty Silicon Valley SJC29 holds 4 published certifications: PCI DSS (the standard required to handle payment card data), ISO 27001 (a certified information security management system), ISO 9001 (a certified quality management system), LEED (a specific compliance or security standard). Together these qualify the facility for regulated workloads spanning security auditing, payments, and healthcare data, though which specific tenants rely on which certification is not disclosed.

California has 22 facilities mapped in this site's dataset, of which 10 publish a megawatt figure, totaling 356 MW.
